principle: High conceptual difficulty, tiny runnable NestJS implementations. Problems are inspired by public engineering patterns and community interviews; not confidential interview transcripts.

groups.title: Fairness, Scheduling and Admission
groups.description: Finite compute, variable work sizes, starvation and overload.

groups.title: Caching, Consistency and Hotspots
groups.description: Stale writes, stampedes, partition movement and hotspot keys.

groups.title: Feeds, Ranking, Search and Crawling
groups.description: Celebrity fan-out, global merge, prefix search and politeness.

groups.title: Distributed Reliability and Data Design
groups.description: Stale regional reads, repeated delivery and identifier allocation.

topics.title: Fair Scheduling for Multi-Tenant Compute
topics.challenge: Google-style resource-scheduling reasoning: stop a 5 GB user's backlog from starving tiny jobs.

topics.title: Fair RAG Ingestion: Gigabytes vs Megabytes
topics.challenge: Split expensive documents into schedulable units without causing duplicate embeddings.

topics.title: Rate Limiting Without Unfair Bursts
topics.challenge: Design a burst-tolerant limiter that still constrains average admitted work.

topics.title: When to Reject Work Rather Than Queue It
topics.challenge: Give latency-critical RPCs a bounded delay and avoid retry storms.

topics.title: Exactly-Once Business Effects from At-Least-Once Requests
topics.challenge: A timeout after charging does not tell the client whether it was charged.

topics.title: Preserving Per-Order Event Order with Parallel Workers
topics.challenge: Messages arrive 2,1,3: apply consistent order without globally serialising everything.

topics.title: Expiring Seat Holds and Fencing Tokens
topics.challenge: A timed-out worker must not confirm a seat that was granted to another customer.

topics.title: Solving the Dual-Write Problem
topics.challenge: Save an order and publish an event when DB commit and broker publish can fail separately.

topics.title: The Cache Fill That Resurrects Deleted Data
topics.challenge: An older in-flight read must not overwrite a newer cache version.

topics.title: One Hot Key, Ten Thousand Simultaneous Misses
topics.challenge: Coalesce cache misses without making recovery depend on one stuck promise.

topics.title: Stable Sharding Versus Hot Keys
topics.challenge: Move few keys when nodes change, yet handle the one celebrity key that consumes 80% of traffic.

topics.title: The Celebrity Fan-Out Problem
topics.challenge: Normal users have 200 followers; a celebrity has 30 million.

topics.title: Exact Global Top-K from Distributed Search Shards
topics.challenge: Each shard sends candidates; can the coordinator produce the true top ten?

topics.title: Search Autocomplete Under a Strict Latency Budget
topics.challenge: Predict the next word with bounded prefix work, ranking and updating.

topics.title: A Web Crawler That Does Not Overload One Host
topics.challenge: Distribute crawling while observing host-specific delays, deduplication and safe fetching.

topics.title: Read Your Writes Across Two Regions
topics.challenge: How can a user see their own update when the nearest replica is behind?

topics.title: Reliable Notifications Without Double-Sending
topics.challenge: At-least-once brokers replay messages; external delivery itself may have unknown results.

topics.title: URL Shortener: Unique IDs Under Concurrent Writers
topics.challenge: What really makes generated links unique and stable through failover?
